book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesu Kirisin bweserun tɔ̃kɑ
Yesu Kirisin bweserun tɔ̃kɑ wee, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Dɑfidin sikɑdobu. Dɑfidi mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Aburɑhɑmun sikɑdobu.
Aburɑhɑmu u Isɑki mɑrɑ, Isɑki u Yɑkɔbu mɑrɑ. Yɑkɔbu u Yudɑ mɑrɑ kɑ win mɑɑbu kɑ wɔnɔbu.
Yudɑ kɑ Tɑmɑri bɑ Fɑrɛsi kɑ Sɑrɑ mɑrɑ. Fɑrɛsi u Esiromu mɑrɑ. Esiromu u Arɑmu mɑrɑ.
Arɑmu u Aminɑdɑbu mɑrɑ. Aminɑdɑbu u Nɑsoni mɑrɑ. Nɑsoni u Sɑɑmɔɔ mɑrɑ.
Sɑɑmɔɔ kɑ Rɑhɑbu bɑ Boɑsi mɑrɑ. Boɑsi kɑ Rutu bɑ Yobɛdi mɑrɑ. Yobɛdi u Isɑi mɑrɑ.
Isɑi u Dɑfidi mɑrɑ. Dɑfidi u kuɑ sunɔ, mɑ wi kɑ wi u rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yurin kurɔ bɑ Sɑlomɔɔ mɑrɑ.
Sɑlomɔɔ u Roboɑmu mɑrɑ. Roboɑmu u Abiɑ mɑrɑ. Abiɑ u Asɑfu mɑrɑ.
Asɑfu u Yosɑfɑti mɑrɑ. Yosɑfɑti u Yorɑmu mɑrɑ. Yorɑmu u Osiɑsi mɑrɑ.
Osiɑsi u Yotɑmu mɑrɑ. Yotɑmu u Akɑsi mɑrɑ. Akɑsi u Esekiɑsi mɑrɑ.
Esekiɑsi u Mɑnɑse mɑrɑ. Mɑnɑse u Amɔɔ mɑrɑ. Amɔɔ u Yosiɑsi mɑrɑ.
Yosiɑsi u Yekoniɑ mɑrɑ kɑ win wɔnɔbu sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ Isirelibɑ ɡurɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ Bɑbilonin temɔ.
Ben Bɑbilonin dɑɑbun biru Yekoniɑ u Sɑlɑtiɛli mɑrɑ. Sɑlɑtiɛli u Sorobɑbɛli mɑrɑ.
Sorobɑbɛli u Abiudu mɑrɑ. Abiudu u Eliɑkimu mɑrɑ. Eliɑkimu u Asoru mɑrɑ.
Asoru u Sɑdɔku mɑrɑ. Sɑdɔku u Asimu mɑrɑ. Asimu u Eliudu mɑrɑ.
Eliudu u Eleɑsɑɑ mɑrɑ. Eleɑsɑɑ u Mɑtɑni mɑrɑ. Mɑtɑni u Yɑkɔbu mɑrɑ.
Yɑkɔbu u Yosɛfu mɑrɑ wi u kuɑ Mɑɑrin durɔ. Mɑɑri wiyɑ, u Yesu mɑrɑ, wi bɑ sokɑ Kirisi.

Nɡe mɛyɑ ben bwese te sɔɔ, sɑɑ Aburɑhɑmun min di n kɑ ɡirɑri Dɑfidin mi, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnu wɔkurɑ nnɛ. Sɑɑ mɑɑ Dɑfidin min di n kɑ ɡirɑri sɑɑ ye bɑ kɑ bu yoru dɑ Bɑbilonin temɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnu wɔkurɑ nnɛ. Yen biru sɑɑ mìn di bɑ kɑ bu dɑ Bɑbilonin temɔ n kɑ Kirisin sɑɑ ɡirɑri, be, bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnu wɔkurɑ nnɛ.
Yesu Kirisin mɑrubu
Wee nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ Yesu Kirisi mɑrɑ. Win mɛro Mɑɑri u sɑ̃ɑ Yosɛfun kurɔ kɛ̃ɛro, ɑdɑmɑ bu sere suɑnɑ Mɑɑri u deemɑ u ɡurɑ mɔ sɑɑ Hunde Dɛɛron min di.
Win durɔ Yosɛfu wi, u sɑ̃ɑ ɡeeɡii, u ǹ kĩ u Mɑɑri sekuru doke bɑtumɑ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u ɡɔ̃ru doke u nùn yinɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ.

Sɑɑ ye u ye bwisikumɔ sɑɑ yerɑ Yinnin ɡɔrɑdo u nùn kure dosu sɔɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yosɛfu, Dɑfidin sikɑdobu ɑ ku bɛrum ko ɑ kɑ wunɛn kurɔ kɛ̃ɛro Mɑɑri yɛnu doke, domi ɡurɑ ye u mɔ mi, sɑɑ Hunde Dɛɛron min diyɑ.
U koo bii tɔn durɔ mɑ, kpɑ ɑ nùn yĩsiru kɛ̃ Yesu
, domi u koo win tɔmbu fɑɑbɑ ko sɑɑ ben durum di.
Yeni kpuro yɑ koorɑ kpɑ Yinnin ɡɑri yi u ɡeruɑ sɑɑ win sɔmɔn nɔɔ sɔɔn di yi kɑ koorɑ,
yi yi nɛɛ,

content.text: “Wɔndiɑ ɡoo u koo ɡurɑ suɑ kpɑ u bii tɔn durɔ mɑ,
kpɑ bu nùn yĩsiru kɛ̃ Emɑnuɛli.”

content: Yĩsi ten tubusiɑnɑ, Gusunɔ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛsɛ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ ye Yosɛfu u yɑndɑ, u kuɑ ye Yinnin ɡɔrɑdo u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ, u Mɑɑri yɛnu doke.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ nùn yɛ̃ kurɔ sere u kɑ win bii tɔn durɔ mɑrɑ. Mɑ u nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Yesu.

footnotes.text: Yesu - Yĩsi ten tubusiɑnɑ fɑɑbɑ kowo.
